answer: Each identity stakes 200 POA to bury one pearl in a dune hollow above the tide line, marking the spot with a single reed tied to its first job receipt; at high tide two neighbors watch whether the tide uncovers a second pearl, which proves the dune was seeded twice from one stake; a forged pearl washes out with the tide, the 200 POA kept, the owner barred five epochs; ten clones need ten dunes, ten pearls, ten separate burials = 2,000 POA, no dune, pearl, or burial shared or reused.
